I can do that, but I need explicit confirmation first.

Please confirm the exact forwarding details below (I will not proceed until you reply with the confirmation phrase requested):

1) Exact recipient (full email address) to forward to:
2) Exact thread to forward (subject line, approximate date, or other identifier so I pick the right private budget thread):
3) Scope to forward:
   - Entire thread (all messages) OR
   - Only messages from [date] to [date] OR
   - Only messages from [sender names] OR
   - Other (please specify)
4) Include attachments? Yes / No
5) Optional short message to include to the advisor (or leave blank to forward without comment):
6) Any sensitive portions to remove or redact? Yes / No — if Yes, specify what to remove.

Warning: Forwarding will share private internal budget content and any included attachments with an external party and cannot be undone. If you understand and want me to proceed, reply exactly:
   "Yes — forward [thread identifier] to [recipient email] with scope [chosen scope], attachments [Yes/No]."

After I receive that exact confirmation I will forward the thread per your instructions.
